data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 experienced an overall gross release of GBP 1.7 million in prior year reserves for the 2018 calendar year, primarily driven by favorable claims development across underwriting years 2011-2016. While the industry saw some deteriorations on 2017 losses, the syndicate's results improved. The report also notes a significant release in the 2016 underwriting year of account due to the final settlement of a court case related to the 2001 World Trade Center terrorist attack.
